title: “S” Key Does Not Work on iPad for Saving Items
summary: With iPadOS 27, typing “a’ on a Magic Keyboard no longer saves an item. A hard reset of the iPad doesn’t help nor does removing the iPad from the keyboard and re-attaching it. There’s no other way to save items this quickly on an iPad.
body_markdown:
# [“S” Key Does Not Work on iPad for Saving Items](https://forum.newsblur.com/t/s-key-does-not-work-on-ipad-for-saving-items/13843)


[problem](https://forum.newsblur.com/c/problem/6)


[NJS](https://forum.newsblur.com/u/NJS)


September 20, 2026, 11:51pm 1


With iPadOS 27, typing “a’ on a Magic Keyboard no longer saves an item. A hard reset of the iPad doesn’t help nor does removing the iPad from the keyboard and re-attaching it. There’s no other way to save items this quickly on an iPad.
